content.short: MelegaSwap is a decentralized exchange on BSC with the widest range of farms and pools.
content.description: MelegaSwap is a decentralized exchange on BSC that enables instant token swaps without registration or requiring an account. The Pools feature lets you earn MARCO and other tokens at no cost, with ongoing MARCO staking generating rewards for participants. Yield Farms provide an avenue to grow MARCO by staking LP tokens. If your trading pair isn't supported on Farms, you can still earn trading fees by staking your tokens in the liquidity pools (LPs), ensuring you benefit from activity across the platform.
